name: manual_31a635
claim: When two independent branches/sessions both attempt to fix the same underlying rule/bug and produce textually different diffs, don't assume they conflict or that one supersedes the other -- install the actual tool (semgrep, in this case) and empirically test both against real positive/negative samples before judging. Two genuinely different-looking fixes can both be correct (same bug, convergent solutions), which is a stronger signal than either fix alone.

decisions.notes: 2026-08-09: bump-agentic-stack-vendor-pin's simplified pt-bash-unquoted-var rule (dropped the pattern-not exclusions) and the already-pushed fix/opengrep-rules-and-guard-sync-dedup's rule (the brace-metavariable plus pattern-not-inside form, the canonical shape from semgrep's own blog post on writing this exact rule type) were assumed to be competing/redundant. Installed semgrep 1.172.0 via uv tool install semgrep and ran both against a 4-line bash sample (2 quoted, 2 unquoted rm -rf VAR usages) -- both rules flagged exactly the 2 unquoted lines and correctly ignored the 2 quoted lines. Confirmed via research that the pushed fix matches semgrep own documented canonical pattern for this rule type verbatim.
